theory.title: Present simple y present continuous para hechos y tendencias
theory.explanation: Usa el present simple para hechos y situaciones habituales. Usa el present continuous para cambios y tendencias en desarrollo, a menudo con verbos como increase (aumentar), become (volverse), grow (crecer) y change (cambiar).
theory.tip: Hechos estables: present simple. Tendencias y cambios actuales: present continuous.

patterns.label: Present simple y present continuous para hechos y tendencias · 1
examples:
The population is growing quickly.
→ La población está creciendo rápidamente.

patterns.label: Present simple y present continuous para hechos y tendencias · 2

The council is improving the bus network, although many residents still walk to work. The river flows through the centre, and several parks provide green spaces. Local businesses are also reducing plastic packaging. These trends suggest that people are becoming more aware of environmental issues.

items.prompt: Describe a trend you are noticing in your town.
items.modelAnswer: I think communities can make a real difference when people work together. In my area, there are several ways to improve the environment, such as using public transport, reducing waste and supporting local projects. Although change can take time, small actions often lead to better results. If more people took part, the community would become cleaner and healthier. I hope that by the next few years we will have made further progress.
